candidate: Eager SYCL Q8_0 KV with fused vision, five full-context slots and batch/microbatch 256
installed_profile: SYCL fused vision with Q8_0 KV, C6 and batch/microbatch 128
public_implementation_scope: This completed run used the historical recipe-authenticated private source overlay. Its recipe binds settings hardcoded in that source, including Q8 KV, batch 256, vision/cache flags and affinity; the private configuration digest alone does not bind them. Public explicit C5/b256 support landed separately at e36cfa6a6c7f8a589f6be42d0e9472b322c1c746 and is not the source executed by this run. This record establishes no normal-service C5 acceptance or deployment.

model_run_inputs.execution_path: Eager SYCL; separate from the later graph-capture candidate
model_run_inputs.kv_storage: Q8_0 for both K and V; block INT8, not FP8

sustained.scope: Repeated four-image synthetic cohort in one loaded worker. Includes endpoint CPU image preparation, queueing, vision, prefill, decode, HTTP completion and final drain; excludes PDF rendering, cold loading, warmup and offline assessment. Source assessment derives the complete expected request extent from the pinned phase records rather than surviving response files.

resources_and_closure.closure_scope: Deliberate owned retirement followed the completed cohort. The inner exit code is retained as that retirement, not an inference failure or natural engine exit. Inner closure is conditional on the unchanged worker joining both drains before setting closed; outer EOF is explicit in its receipt. This experimental ten-second wrapper supplies no normal-service 300-second idle timing or C5 cancellation/recovery/CLI acceptance.
resources_and_closure.memory_scope: These nested process/Job commit-accounting peaks overlap and must not be added. They are not resident RAM or VRAM measurements and establish no future memory bound. Endpoint physical/global-commit observations are not interval minima. The experimental outer forecasts belong to this private owner; the normal production outer lease does not implement them.

prior_refused_attempt.scope: Separate pre-child physical-headroom refusal, not an OOM, inference failure or throughput result. The later successful attempt used fresh ownership after a new headroom observation without changing forecasts, reserves or hard caps; it does not replace the refused attempt.

comparisons.basis: Full-cohort correct pages/s including fill and drain

installed_q8_c6_b128.scope: Same Q8_0 text and KV storage, projector and fused-vision leaf. Concurrency and batch/microbatch change together; the gain is not a separate causal estimate for either setting.

bf16_kv_c4_b128_repeat.scope: This comparison changes KV precision as well as concurrency and batch; it is not an unchanged-BF16 speedup.

vulkan_c4_b128_original_endpoint.scope: Different backend/profile and a shorter reference window; this is a descriptive whole-profile comparison.

comparisons.limits: One unpaired C5 observation on four repeated images. No paired estimate, confidence interval, general accuracy ordering or hardware ceiling follows. Equal quantization labels do not establish identical intermediate arithmetic or numerical equivalence at changed batch/concurrency.

limits.cache_counter_scope: Recorded cache counters are null, not proof of zero cache use; prompt/cache reuse was disabled by the intended request/runtime policy, without an independent measurement of all reused work.
limits.numerical_scope: Prior selected Q8 decoder/operator and vision comparisons retain their original profile and tensor scopes. This C5 source-content/localization cohort is not a new numerical oracle or a broader corpus assessment.
limits.process_state_scope: Configuration and completed closure statements refer to their recorded boundaries; no current process/service state is attested.

privacy_and_integrity_scope: Raw requests, responses, phase records, logs, recipes, runtime binaries, private configuration and machine-private paths remain outside public Git. These SHA256 commitments bind retained local evidence, not independent remote attestation. Curation used local reads and hashes only, without rerunning inference, the client or the source assessor.
